events.description: An account blocked another. Consumers must drop cached feed candidates and conversations between the two.
A post passed screening and was published. Feed fan-out consumes this; it must still re-check visibility at serve time.
A post's audience changed. Caches and search must re-evaluate visibility.
A post was deleted by its author or removed. Consumers purge it from caches, search and CDN.
A message was stored. Metadata only: no body or ciphertext ever leaves the messaging context in events.
Pre-publish screening produced a verdict. Feeds per-language precision and recall measurement.
An enforcement action was recorded. Always names the policy and the kind of decider.
A human reviewer decided an appeal.
A civic case event was recorded (a transition, or a side event such as escalate). Mirrors civic.case_events.
Evidence was attached. Carries the hash, never the file or its storage key.
An Ombudsman case moved state. Consumed only by the Ombudsman deployment and the transparency report.
